situations.title: 환자 2인 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm your name and date of birth.
situations.brief: 표준 절차에 따라 이름·생년월일로 환자를 2인 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you state your full name for me?
And your date of birth, please?
I'm checking this against your wristband.

situations.title: 낙상 위험 초기 사정
situations.tagline: Let me ask a few questions about falls and steadiness.
situations.brief: 병력·약물·거동을 바탕으로 낙상 위험을 초기 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had any falls in the past year?
Do you take any medicines that make you dizzy?
Do you use a cane or walker at home?

situations.title: 침상 안전 설정
situations.tagline: Let me set up your bed so you stay safe.
situations.brief: 침상 높이·난간·호출벨 등 침상 안전을 설정하고 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm lowering the bed and putting the rails up.
This is your call button — press it if you need help.
Please don't get up on your own; call me first.

situations.title: 알레르기 밴드 확인
situations.tagline: Let's double-check your allergy band.
situations.brief: 알레르기 밴드의 표식과 기록을 대조해 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Your band says you're allergic to penicillin, correct?
Any other allergies we should add?
This red band alerts everyone on the team.

situations.title: 이송 전 안전 확인
situations.tagline: Before we move you, let me check a few things.
situations.brief: 검사실 이송 전 라인·산소·낙상 등 안전 요소를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm making sure your IV line is secure.
Your oxygen tank is full for the trip.
Please stay lying down while we move you.

situations.title: 고위험 낙상 환자 관리
situations.tagline: Please wait for me before you stand up.
situations.brief: 섬망·진정으로 낙상 위험이 높은 환자를 감시하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: You're a bit unsteady, so let me help you move.
Press this button and I'll come right away.
For now, stay in bed so you don't fall.

situations.title: 투약 오류 예방
situations.tagline: This looks like a high-alert drug — verify with me.
situations.brief: 유사명·고농도 약물의 투약 오류를 동료와 이중확인으로 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Is this hydralazine or hydroxyzine? Let's confirm.
Can you verify the concentration with me?
Right patient, right dose — read it back to me.

situations.title: 신원 불명 환자 등록
situations.tagline: Let's assign a temporary ID until we know who he is.
situations.brief: 무의식 신원 불명 환자에게 임시 식별번호를 부여하고 팀과 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Register him as unknown male, trauma alpha.
Put the temporary band on and label all samples with it.
We'll update the record once we identify him.

situations.title: 검체 라벨 오류 방지
situations.tagline: Let's cross-check these labels before they go out.
situations.brief: 다환자 검체의 라벨 오류를 동료와 함께 대조해 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: This tube is for bed four, not bed six — let's confirm.
Read me the name and the order together.
We label at the bedside, never at the desk.
goals: 다환자 검체 라벨을 동료와 대조 확인한다

situations.title: 낙상 발생 후 대응
situations.tagline: Don't move yet — let me check you over first.
situations.brief: 낙상이 발생한 환자를 사정하고 보고·재발 방지로 이어지도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stay still — can you tell me where it hurts?
Did you hit your head at all?
I'm going to check you before we move you up.
goals: 낙상 후 손상 여부를 우선 사정한다

situations.title: 억제대 사용 안전
situations.tagline: Let me explain why the restraints are needed right now.
situations.brief: 억제대의 필요성·순환 확인·최소 사용 원칙을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This is temporary, only to keep him from pulling his lines.
We check his circulation and skin every hour.
We'll remove them as soon as it's safe.

situations.title: 감염 격리 설명
situations.tagline: Here's what to know before you visit in isolation.
situations.brief: 감염 격리의 필요성과 방문 규정을 방문 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in isolation to protect others from infection.
Please wear this gown, gloves, and mask before entering.
Wash your hands well when you go in and out.

situations.title: 자살 위험 환경 안전
situations.tagline: I want to keep you safe, so let's set the room up together.
situations.brief: 자살 위험 환자의 환경에서 위험물을 제거하고 감시 계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm keeping the room safe for you right now.
Someone will stay with you at all times.
You're not in trouble — we just want to help.

situations.title: 오환자 시술 방지
situations.tagline: Let's do the time-out before we start.
situations.brief: 시술 직전 팀 타임아웃으로 환자·부위·시술을 최종 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Time-out: this is John Reyes, date of birth in 1962.
We're doing a right chest tube — everyone agree?
Consent is signed and the site is marked.

situations.title: 급변 환자 조기 경고
situations.tagline: Her vitals are deteriorating — I'm calling rapid response.
situations.brief: 활력징후가 악화되는 환자를 조기에 인지하고 신속대응팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Her heart rate is up and pressure is dropping.
Respiratory rate is thirty and she's confused.
I need eyes on her now — this is a rapid response.

situations.title: 다환자 혼동 위기
situations.tagline: It's crowded — let's re-verify who's who before we act.
situations.brief: 혼잡한 환경에서 환자 신원 혼동 위기를 재확인으로 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: Two patients have similar names — let's double-check bands.
Confirm the medical record number, not just the name.
Let's slow down for ten seconds and get this right.

situations.title: 낙상 후 두부외상
situations.tagline: You hit your head, and you're on a blood thinner — this needs urgent checks.
situations.brief: 항응고제를 복용하는 낙상 후 두부외상 환자를 응급 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Because you take a blood thinner, we need a head scan fast.
Tell me if your headache gets worse or you feel sleepy.
Do you feel any numbness or trouble seeing?
goals: 항응고 관련 출혈 위험을 신속히 평가한다

situations.title: 투약 위해사건 대응
situations.tagline: A wrong dose was given — let's act and report now.
situations.brief: 오투약 후 환자 조치와 사건 보고를 관리자와 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The patient got double the ordered dose.
We're monitoring her vitals and notifying the doctor.
I'll complete an incident report right away.
goals: 오투약 후 환자 안전 조치를 우선한다

situations.title: 화재·대피 안전
situations.tagline: Code red — let's move patients in priority order.
situations.brief: 화재 상황에서 환자 대피 우선순위를 팀과 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Ambulatory patients out this exit first.
The intubated patient needs a team to move the bed.
Close doors behind us and account for everyone.

situations.title: 다직역 안전 브리핑
situations.tagline: Let's brief the team on this patient's key risks.
situations.brief: 위중 환자의 위험 요소를 다직역 팀과 공유하는 안전 브리핑을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Key risks are aspiration and a difficult airway.
She's a high fall risk and on anticoagulation.
Everyone clear on their role if she deteriorates?
goals: 위중 환자의 핵심 위험을 팀에 공유한다
악화 시 각자의 역할을 사전 합의한다
